summary_md: **HOPE. ([@rlaope](https://x.com/rlaope/status/2115642347543470221))** added built-in video-generation skills to **oh-my-hermes**, an open-source skills/harness package for Hermes Agent: hyperframe clips, reels-style videos, 3D modeling renders, pixel art and more. He says all his recent interaction videos were made with it, mostly using Opus and Kimi under the hood.
